_meta.policy: Zero fabrication. The Florida Product Approval portal (floridabuilding.org) publishes FL# (approval number), Type (New/Revision), Category/Subcategory, Manufacturer, Validated By, and Status. It does NOT publish expiration date, system/series name, or design pressure on its public results or detail pages — those values appear only inside the individual approval PDFs. Miami-Dade NOA data sourced separately from miamidade.gov/building. Cells marked 'pending verification' have not yet been hand-confirmed against the source. Cells marked 'not in public portal — see source PDF' are not displayed in the public-facing FPA search results.

tgp.label: TGP (Technical Glass Products)
tgp.portal_note: Technical Glass Products is not listed in the Florida Product Approval portal under that name. TGP fire-rated glazing is regulated by IBC/NFPA test methods (UL 9, UL 10B, UL 263, NFPA 252, NFPA 257) rather than the Florida wind-load product-approval system. ACG verifies TGP listings against UL Online Certifications Directory and Intertek Directory of Listed Products for each project.
